Chapter 483: Chapter 18: Five Hundred Years (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 483: Chapter 18: Five Hundred Years (Subscription Request)_2

Lin Yuan did take an extra look at the Chaotic Celestial King.

That was good, it spared him the extra effort.

“Separate your soul fragment, let me perform Soul Search,” Lin Yuan said directly.

He chose not to directly perform the Soul Search, which was a response to the Chaotic Celestial King’s initiative to cooperate.

Separating a soul fragment for Lin Yuan to perform Soul Search, compared to being suppressed by Lin Yuan before the Soul Search, had no significant difference, but it was much better in terms of saving face.

“No problem.”

...

The Chaotic Celestial King unhesitatingly split off a part of his soul fragment.

This part of the soul fragment contained all his memories, and Lin Yuan only needed to perform Soul Search on this soul fragment to know everything he wanted to know.

Hum.

Lin Yuan took over the soul fragment from the Chaotic Celestial King.

Within a few breaths, the Soul Search was complete.

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan had some realizations in his heart.

In the memory of the Chaotic Celestial King, there was the reason for the closing of the Prehistoric Era.

A treasure fell from the Ninth Layer of Heaven at the end of the Prehistoric Era.

This treasure led to a great battle among many Supreme Immortal Kings of the Prehistoric Era.

That battle caused the Spirit Realm to seem like it had entered doomsday, with Tribulation Stage Celestial Kings falling in great numbers.

Ultimately, as the victor, the Chaotic Celestial King obtained that treasure and entered the Eighth Layer of Heaven with many under his command.

After the Prehistoric Era.

The Spirit Realm took a long time to recover, gradually entering the next era.

The Three Thousand Dao States Era.

Up to today, the Three Thousand Dao States Era is still in its early stage, not even a thousandth of the Prehistoric Era.

“Give me the treasure.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Chaotic Celestial King.

In the Prehistoric Era, the Chaotic Celestial King was only one of the strongest.

There were a few Supreme Immortal Kings comparable to him, capable of compelling the Chaotic Celestial King to risk battling peers and initiate a Supreme Immortal King-level clash.

Clearly, the treasure was critically important.

“This is that treasure.”

The Chaotic Celestial King hesitated for a moment, then promptly handed over the treasure.

Having completed the Soul Search on his soul fragment, Lin Yuan’s understanding of that treasure was no lesser than his, with no need for any concealment.

The treasure handed over by the Chaotic Celestial King was an irregular stone, with faint traces of a mysterious force emanating, suffused with a primordial aura.

“This stone contains an aura of Power of Creation beyond the higher Power of Creation. As long as one can comprehend it, even if unable to take that step, one can still advance greatly in the realm of the Supreme Immortal King…”

The Chaotic Celestial King explained in a low voice, looking at the irregular stone in Lin Yuan’s hand.

“Unfortunately, after so many years, I have never comprehended it, even though I’ve been nearing the Ninth Layer of Heaven, I have never grasped it…”

The tone of the Chaotic Celestial King conveyed an indescribable sentiment.

The mysterious aura emanating from the Ninth Layer of Heaven was similar to that of the stone, and the Chaotic Celestial King believed that being near the Ninth Layer of Heaven for a long time would aid in comprehending the stone.

But over the years, the Chaotic Celestial King’s understanding of the stone had reached a standstill, and the mysterious Power of Creation exceeding the higher Power of Creation remained elusive.

This was also the reason he was so decisive in handing over the stone.

Because the Chaotic Celestial King felt that even if given another era, ten eras, he would almost never comprehend the Power of Creation within the stone.

“Power of Creation beyond the higher Power of Creation?” Lin Yuan observed the irregular stone seriously.

Compared to the Chaotic Celestial King’s limited understanding, Lin Yuan hailed from the Main World, understood the essence of Cosmic Force, and knew that power surpassing higher Cosmic Force was something only a Ninth Rank Evolver could control.

Lin Yuan carefully examined the irregular stone.

[Your discernment is exceptional, observing the Mysterious Origin, deepening your mastery over its power…]

…

[Your discernment is exceptional, observing the Mysterious Origin, deepening your mastery over its power…]

…

[Your discernment is exceptional, observing the Mysterious Origin, deepening your mastery over its power…]

…

“Mysterious Origin…” Lin Yuan contemplated internally.

One thing was certain; the aura within this irregular stone indeed surpassed the higher Power of Creation.

Having observed it for a while, if it were any other higher Power of Creation, he would have at least grasped something, but facing this irregularly shaped stone, he still had no gains.

Of course, the ‘no significant gains’ here refers to the gains being too insubstantial to be noticed.

“The Ninth Layer of Heaven.”

Lin Yuan stored the irregular stone and looked up towards the distant entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven.

Compared to the entrances of the previous eight layers, the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven was incredibly broad, as if welcoming supreme immortal kings to ascend.

However, in reality, after having executed a soul search on the Chaotic Celestial King’s memories, Lin Yuan knew that the tribulations leading to the Ninth Layer of Heaven were terrifyingly formidable.

Inside the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven, there lie the life imprints of the ten strongest supreme immortal kings in the history of the Spirit Realm.

That is to say, to enter the Ninth Layer of Heaven, one must defeat the ten strongest supreme immortal kings ever to have existed in the Spirit Realm.

In fact, to call them the ten strongest supreme immortal kings is somewhat imprecise.

They should be referred to as the ten strongest beings.

Because perhaps some of the supreme immortal kings have already taken half a step beyond.

The Prehistoric Era, the Three Thousand Dao Provinces Era.

These are just the two most recent epochs.

Before these epochs, there existed even more ancient epochs.

No one knows when the Spirit Realm was born, and although the supreme immortal kings existed alongside the Spirit Realm, it doesn’t mean they won’t die.

Not to mention, the end of the Prehistoric Era saw the demise of a great number of supreme immortal kings.

“With the strength of the Martial Ancestor, one could certainly make a breakthrough at the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven,” the Chaotic Celestial King murmured.

He had attempted it, but was unable to defeat even the first supreme immortal king’s life imprint and was nearly crushed, managing to retreat only with great difficulty.

“Do you want to watch me make a try?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Chaotic Celestial King, “No rush.”

Even Lin Yuan would not underestimate the ten strongest beings in the history of the Spirit Realm.

It’s not a matter of one era or one epoch, but since the birth of the Spirit Realm itself.

Lin Yuan indeed intended to challenge the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven, but not now; he would wait until his power reached its peak before trying.

Currently, although Lin Yuan surpassed such beings of an epoch as the Chaotic Celestial King, he was far from reaching his own limits.

The green liquid in the Mysterious Gourd could still be absorbed further.

The Martial Tao Evolution System Eighth Stage had yet to be completely unlocked.

A complete core space model had also not been fully realized.

The cultivation of the Taiji Power, too, had not yet reached the Third Realm.

The several other high-grade powers of creation, along with many ordinary powers of creation, were merely at the First Realm.

There was also that irregular stone obtained from the Chaotic Celestial King, which contained a mysterious power of creation surpassing the superior powers of creation.

The Chaotic Celestial King might not have deciphered it, but that doesn’t mean Lin Yuan couldn’t; it was only a matter of how much time it would take.

Lin Yuan was still far from his ultimate limit.

During this traversal, Lin Yuan’s allowed residence time had a limit of over nine hundred years, of which only just over four hundred years had passed.

Before clearly understanding what kinds of unexpected events might occur upon entering the entrance to the Ninth Layer of Heaven, Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t rashly proceed.

The Chaotic Celestial King had previously made an attempt but quickly retreated because he faced the first life imprint.

That’s why retreat was still an option.

Lin Yuan wasn’t sure whether, if he ventured deeper and failed, he would still be able to retreat.

In such circumstances, Lin Yuan naturally opted for stability.

Other supreme immortal kings yearned to ascend to the Ninth Layer of Heaven because they wished to take that next step.

Lin Yuan did not have this desire. In the Main World, many evolution paths were perfected, and Lin Yuan had many directions for advancing into the Ninth Rank,

His task now was to securely spend the rest of his alloted time, converting it into gains to take back to the Main World.

“Right,”

“All of you immortal kings, hand over a strand of your powers of creation to me.

Lin Yuan surveyed the Chaotic Celestial King and other Prehistoric Era supreme immortal kings and commanded.

“Yes.”

The Chaotic Celestial King hesitated, unsure of what Lin Yuan needed so much power of creation for, but dared not ask further and obediently shared a strand of his own power of creation.

“Very good, very good.”

Lin Yuan looked at the dozens of strands of powers of creation, including several high-grade ones he had never seen before, feeling quite satisfied.

And so it was.

Lin Yuan, in his true form, stayed stationed before the entrance leading to the Ninth Layer of Heaven and once again began his meditation for enlightenment.

Time passed.

Five hundred years flew by like flowing water.
